title: Access and use Zoom Meetings
issue: You need to access or request Zoom Meetings
resolution_html:
1. Open yorku.zoom.us and select Sign In
  2. Authenticate with your Passport York account
  3. Schedule or start a meeting from your York Zoom profile
  4. Set the meeting security and recording options appropriate to the session

For an access problem, contact askIT with the service name and relevant error
